title: Mobile App Logging for Diabetes in Pregnancy
official: Effect of a Mobile Application on Blood Sugar Testing Compliance in Pregnant Women With Diabetes
summary: To determine the effect of using a mobile app versus paper logs on compliance and percentage in range blood sugars in monitoring blood sugar in pregnant women with diabetes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years and older
* Verified intrauterine pregnancy
* At least 12 weeks gestation
* Diagnosed with either type 2 diabetes mellitus or gestational diabetes mellitus.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with less than 4 weeks anticipated to be remaining in pregnancy
* Pre-existing use of a continuous glucose monitor or other mobile application for glucose tracking
* Type 1 diabetes mellitus
* Non-English speaking patients
